_comment: Hue bands for the colour rule in pi/vision/leafs.py. Hue is OpenCV's 0..179 scale, so 30 is 60 degrees. Saturation and value are 0..255. Ranges are inclusive. Edit these from the dashboard's vision page.
_why: The provided bands only cover hue 5..85, which is red through green. A dead brown leaf held in shadow reads far darker and bluer than a fresh green one, so it can score zero on all three and come out 'borderline'. Widening a band or adding a lower value floor is how you fix that.
